poll.notes: Two-named-candidate ballot (no third candidate listed); first-choice style question, not ranked-choice. MoE +/-6.3. State oversample within a 3,644-voter multistate NetChoice (tech trade association) survey; already-voted respondents' choices merged with full-ballot and leaner responses. Release page: https://netchoice.org/netchoice-echelon-insights-poll-voters-rank-ai-regulation-far-behind-cost-of-living-want-one-national-ai-standard/ Recorded as round FIRST: a first-choice question in a ranked-choice race, the same basis as the other Maine polls (Marist, Fox/Beacon/Shaw, Trafalgar) in polls.csv.

pollster.weighting_quote: The sample was weighted to reflect modeled turnout and demographic characteristics of the population of voters in the 2026 likely electorate based on a probabilistic model that incorporates data from the US Census Bureau's American Community Survey and Current Population Survey Voting and Registration Supplement, as well as L2 voter file data. Weighting dimensions included gender, age, race/ethnicity, education, designated market area (DMA), turnout probability, party by ideology, as well as gender by age.
